<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex61042023-09-26-093717" status="unreviewed">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Closing verse (18a1-3)"/>
      <lg>   <l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5085">bshad mnyan la 'jug pa'i sgron ma</rs> 'di |</l> 
        <l> bstan gzhi <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">snar thang <lb n="18a3"/> dgon pa</rs>r sbyar || </l>
        <l> de yi dge bas 'gro kun gyi ||</l>
       <l>  mun sel kun mkhyen thob par shog | </l></lg>
        <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (18a3)"/>
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5085">chos bshad la 'jug pa'i yan lag tshig gi sgron mas don gyi mun pa sel ba</rs> zhes bya ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="3977">shAkya'i dge slong nam mkha' grags</rs> kyis sbyar ba'o || || || dge'o ||</seg></TEI>
